comparison.objective: Orient stack-nest totes so they stack on full totes instead of nesting into their contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Infer asymmetric tote orientation and lower each tote onto load-bearing ledges.
comparison.success_condition: Both grey totes must rest released on the ledges without descending into or disturbing the parts boxes.
comparison.reason: Both penalize loss of support, but tote stacking tests orientation-dependent placement onto ledges. It does not require a support-to-support sliding handoff or preservation of free rolling elements.
